paragraphs: CUES sells equipment and software for inspecting and rehabilitating sewer pipes. Alongside cameras, cutters and transporters, the company keeps pre-built, demo and trade-in vehicles on hand for quick delivery.

Its GraniteNet product is inspection and decision support software for water, wastewater, stormwater and municipal public works asset management. That software is certified for all NASSCO Version 8 standards, covering PACP, LACP and MACP. A separate mapping service adds utility locating through a probe the company supplies.

Buyers are municipalities, utilities, government agencies and other public sector organizations, reached in Canada through a cooperative purchasing organization that has approved CUES as a supplier. The company has also been awarded a contract through Sourcewell, another cooperative purchasing program. CUES points to more than 64 years in the business. It describes its pipeline inspection and rehabilitation equipment as American-made and built to last.

quote.text: Long lasting, American-made pipeline inspection & rehabilitation equipment
